name: zdeck-public-stack
description: Public Z-Deck firmware layer for LilyGO T-Deck/T-Deck Plus on Meshtastic 2.8. Adds the Z-Deck identity/version surface, validated quick handoff between Z-Deck and MeshCore app slots, forced LongFast public default behavior, on-device WiFi scan/select, a state-driven map/compass/DeFlock/distance-alert controller with persistent mode tabs and first-fix GPS recovery, persistent map page defaults, offline/SD map prep, tile progress and missing-tile status, compact map/cache overlays, coordinate-aware GPS readout, clearer message delivery labels, hop counters where packet route data exposes them, latest-activity chat ordering, node-name fallback cleanup, SD message journal support, SD settings backup/restore support, SD prepare/reset tools, screen correction tools, serial recovery, a boot progress bar, selectable themes, a public on-device health panel, app-only Wi-Fi updates, home LoRa RX overlap fixes, persistent sidebar-left/right placement, and a bounded top header that keeps battery icon/percent visible.

release.label: Z-Deck 0.2.54-cyberdeck
release.channelDefaults: LongFast public setup; users add private/admin channels after flashing

targetDevice.sdCard: Supported for maps, local message journal, settings backups, ringtone storage, logs, and prepare/reset setup; USB mass storage is disabled in this public build to keep serial stable.

build.status: WSL PlatformIO app and LittleFS builds passed. zdeck55 adds strict GNSS quality acceptance, queued OTA/SD actions, two Z-Deck OTA slots, and a dedicated MeshCore partition.

publicSetup.ownerDefault: Meshtastic xxxx until the owner name is configured
publicSetup.shortNameDefault: xxxx until the short name is configured
publicSetup.notes: Users can add their own channels, PSKs, owner names, and admin configuration after flashing with the Meshtastic app or CLI. No private channel data is shipped.
